now.title: Blade: Trinity
now.text: Dr. Edgar Vance, a psychiatrist secretly serving the vampires, declares Blade psychotic so he can be handed over to them.

proposed.text: Dr. Edgar Vance, a psychiatrist secretly serving the vampires, declares Blade psychotic so he can be handed over to them. After Blade escapes, Drake kills him in his office and takes his shape.

changes.evidence: In Blade: Trinity, after the Nightstalkers free Blade, Drake kills Vance in his office and takes his form to ambush them; Vance's body is found behind his desk. The file's only record leaves him At large, but the film leaves him dead.

now.title: Captain Marvel
now.text: Refugee Skrulls hide on Earth from the Kree, and Carol Danvers leaves with them to find a new home.

proposed.text: Refugee Skrulls hide from the Kree in Mar-Vell's cloaked lab orbiting Earth, and Carol Danvers leaves with them to find a new home.

changes.evidence: In Captain Marvel, the refugees (including Talos's family) are hidden in Mar-Vell's cloaked laboratory orbiting Earth, not on Earth itself.
